tools.name: find_matching_tenders
tools.description: Find open public sector tenders and government contracts in the UK and Europe that may suit a particular business, from a short description of what it does or its public website. Each result says which words or procurement categories matched. A match is not a judgement of eligibility.

tools.name: get_tender_details
tools.description: Full stored details of one public tender: description, buyer, value, deadline, CPV codes, conditions quoted from the notice where available, and the official notice link.

tools.name: get_market_coverage
tools.description: Which European countries and public procurement sources are searchable, how many open notices each currently has, and when the data was last updated.

tools.description: Request Monday-to-Friday email alerts of new public tenders for a business: each night Get Contract Alerts checks newly published tenders in the chosen European countries and emails the ones that fit the business the next weekday morning, once each. tools.name: list_supported_countries

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: start_tender_alerts · Public sink: start_tender_alerts.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: start_tender_alerts · Public sink: start_tender_alerts

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
